verdict.rationale: Muse documents that VM files and 'everything Muse generates or uses on your behalf' can be inspected and downloaded, and provides activity/audit logs, but there is no explicit statement of a full chat-history or account-data export feature. missing for 10: explicit 'export my data' / GDPR-style data export flow, evidence of exporting full chat history (not just VM files), and any independent confirmation this works as described.
